title: [Decision] A runtime-created package's navigationContributions are accepted and never applied: make them work, or refuse them?
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

The maintainer: 「等我决定的都要立卡，并且从业务的角度给我具体解释和我沟通」 (2026-11-04). Measured by the seat on `main` `63b86b385d`, on the example CRM unless noted. No `domain:*` label is set: triage routes this card.

## The question

A person or an AI creates a package at runtime with a menu entry for another app. The server says success and stores it, and the entry never appears, even after a restart. Nothing says why. Should the platform honour it, or refuse it?

Governing text: `packages/spec/src/kernel/manifest.zod.ts` (`navigationContributions`), ADR-0029 D7, ADR-0049 (enforce or remove). #30059 already covers the customer's own menu through an app override, so this is about what the manifest key promises.

## Measured

- `POST /api/v1/packages` with `navigationContributions` targeting `crm_app`: 201, stored.
- `GET /api/v1/meta/app/crm_app`: no entry. `GET /api/v1/packages/com.example.crm/customizations`: `contributions` empty.
- After a backend restart: the package is `installed` and enabled, its manifest still holds the entry, and the app still has no entry.
- `PATCH /api/v1/packages/com.example.crm.custom` with the key: 400, "Body { name?, description?, version?, dependencies? } — nothing to update".

## Code readings

`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts:9375-9379`: `engine.registerApp` is the only path calling `registerAppNavContribution`. A runtime install goes through `registry.installPackage` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-install.ts:310`), which does not.

## Options

- **A. Refuse loudly:** the runtime door refuses the key and says the customer route is an app override (#30059), and a contribution is shipped in a code package.
- **B. Make it work:** register on install and at boot, and handle update, disable and uninstall.
- **C. Leave it.**

## Recommendation: A

## 四轴分析

**实际业务需求。** 客户加菜单已经由 #30059 解决。这个键的实际用途是合作伙伴发布的包，而它们从代码加载，已经生效。运行时手工建包再贡献导航，目前说不出真实场景；真有人这样做，今天只会困惑。

**项目长远合理性。** 平台的规则是声明了就要兑现，要么补实现要么拒绝。A 现在就让规则成立；以后有场景再做 B，不会有迁移成本。

**防 AI 写错。** 这条最重要。AI 建包写上这个键，得到成功响应，却不生效，还会告诉用户做完了。A 在结构上杜绝这种情况。

**创业阶段不扩散。** A 改动很小。B 要补注册、撤销和多节点同步，为一个没有场景的路径付出不值。

| 棱 | A | B | C |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 业务 | 中 | 中 | 弱 |
| 长远 | 强 | 强 | 弱 |
| 防错 | 强 | 强 | 弱 |
| 不扩散 | 强 | 弱 | 强 |

## Re-check

`git grep -n "navigationContributions" origin/main -- packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-install.ts`
